build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where a ball must pass through a hole in the ground
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable scale and position in the PHYRE scene
create_static_bar: create a static bar object with configurable scale and position in the PHYRE scene
update_task_goal: update the task goal to require the ball touching the bottom wall using C.update_task
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameters by raising creator_lib.SkipTemplateParams when ball is bigger than hole
